ops.text: Local `uv run great-docs build` is broken in captain-hook since the shared docs-build fragment change (0dc30013, "gd-build absorbs titles + swatch"): great-docs.yml references docs/scripts/.gd-build/native_reference_titles.py, which only CI materializes — locally the pre-render step dies with "No such file or directory" at Step 17 and the build fails. Docs CI on main stays green, so the gap is invisible until someone tries to validate a docs change locally (I burned two 2.5-minute build runs discovering this). Either the fragment should materialize .gd-build locally on first build, or the local-build path in docs/development/index.qmd needs a bootstrap step.
